vendor_categories.name: Catering & Beverages
default_questions: Does the per-plate cost include live counter setups and basic service staff?
What is the policy for food wastage or unexpected additional guests (e.g. +10% buffer)?
Can you accommodate pure vegetarian, Jain, or specific allergy requirements separately?
Are chafing dishes, premium cutlery, and drinking water jars included in the quote?

vendor_categories.name: Venue & Banquet
default_questions: What is the sound curfew and generator backup policy during peak hours?
Are there mandatory in-house vendor restrictions (decor, sound, DJ, catering)?
What are the check-in and checkout timings, and are bridal rooms provided complimentary?
Is valet parking available and what are the municipal clearance requirements?

vendor_categories.name: Decor & Florals
default_questions: Will seasonal/local flowers be used to optimize freshness and cost?
Does the quote include ambient lighting, fairy lights, and stage focus lights?
What is the teardown policy and is there a security deposit for structural props?

vendor_categories.name: Photography & Video
default_questions: How many candid vs traditional shooters and drone operators will be on-site?
What is the exact deliverable timeline for the teaser, traditional video, and raw photos?
Will there be travel/accommodation costs billed separately if outside the city center?

vendor_categories.name: Bridal/Groom Attire & Makeup
default_questions: How many trials or fittings are included in the bridal/groom styling package?
Does the makeup artist package include hair styling, draping, and touch-up staff on-site?
What is the overtime charge if ceremonies run beyond scheduled hours?

vendor_categories.name: Music, DJ & Entertainment
default_questions: Do you have the necessary public performance licenses (PPL/IPRS) covered?
Can we provide a custom do-not-play list and cultural folk music preferences?
What audio equipment (mics, monitors, speakers) is included in the package?

vendor_categories.name: Invitations, Favors & Stationery
default_questions: What is the turnaround time for digital animated invites and printed boxes?
Are edible return favors packaged with expiry dates and seal freshness?
What is the unit cost discount if quantity increases by 20%?

task_templates.title: Finalize guest count and overall budget ceiling
Inspect & book venue with advance payment and written contract
Conduct food tasting and lock catering contract
Hire photographer & videographer team

Dispatch digital/physical invitations with RSVP tracking
Complete final fittings for ceremony outfits & confirm makeup timing
Confirm arrival timeline, backup generators, and contact sheets for all vendors
Designate family point-of-contact for vendor payments and guest reception

vendor_categories.name: Food & Refreshments
default_questions: Do you have kid-friendly and elder-friendly snacks with low spice options?
Are beverage dispensers and disposable or reusable cutlery included?

vendor_categories.name: Custom Cake & Dessert Table
default_questions: Can you deliver the theme cake in a temperature-controlled vehicle at the exact time?
Are eggless or vegan flavor options available without extra surcharge?

vendor_categories.name: Theme Decor & Balloons
default_questions: Are you using biodegradable balloon arches and reusable theme backdrops?
How much setup time do you need before the party starts?

vendor_categories.name: Games, Anchor & Entertainment
default_questions: Will the game host bring age-appropriate party games and small token prizes?
Do you provide a portable PA speaker and mic system?

vendor_categories.name: Party Venue / Hall
default_questions: Is there dedicated space for cake cutting, dancing, and dining?
Can we bring our own cake and decor without paying outside vendor fees?

vendor_categories.name: Party Photography
default_questions: How many hours of coverage are included and will you capture cake cutting moments?
Will edited photos be delivered within 3-5 days?

Reserve venue or club house party hall
Design and order custom theme cake
Book theme decorator and game host / entertainer

vendor_categories.name: Community Feast (Langar/Prasad)
default_questions: Can you manage continuous bulk serving during peak hours?
Are food safety, hygiene caps, and pure satvik preparations guaranteed?

vendor_categories.name: Pandal, Tent & Seating
default_questions: Are waterproof canopy structures, carpet runners, and adequate fans/misters included?
Is the structure certified for fire safety clearance and emergency exits?

vendor_categories.name: Sound, PA & Generator Backup
default_questions: Are wireless mics provided for speakers/singers and announcements?
Is a heavy-duty silent diesel generator included with fuel backup?

vendor_categories.name: Sanitation, Volunteers & Waste
default_questions: Are portable bio-toilets or dedicated cleaning personnel stationed throughout?
What is the segregation and eco-friendly wet/dry waste disposal plan?

Confirm community kitchen / bulk catering menu and raw material supplies
Assign crowd management, queue control, and Prasad distribution teams
Test sound system, verify fire extinguishers, and inspect entry/exit gates

default_questions: Can you curate a signature menu reflecting family nostalgia or regional specialties?
Are live grill or dessert counters possible at the venue?

Are AV projector screens available for family memory slideshows?

Are warm fairy lights and candle-light centerpieces included?

Are dedicated breakout meeting rooms and tea-break foyers included?

Is an on-site AV technician stationed throughout the event?
